reason_codes.meaning: Complete accepted evidence supports presently operative searchable text.
Validly enacted material is not yet proved operative.
The material's present effect is fully represented by another tracked current authority.
Accepted evidence proves that the material no longer supplies current authority.
A material identity, effect, ownership, evidence, alignment, replacement, or conflict fact remains unresolved.
An operative event is proved but required current consolidation evidence is missing.
Publication or one source signal alone cannot establish a primary disposition.
